test_cases.title: Participant details page shows the fields and buttons
acs: DERIVED: /EditParticipantDetails.aspx shows h1 My account, the participant fields and the buttons UPDATE DETAILS and CANCEL - route /EditParticipantDetails.aspx (crawl, docs/discovery/coverage-plan.md)
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
Read-only: nothing is changed and no button is selected.
Field data: Contact Name, Organisation Name, Address 1, Address 2, Address 3 (optional), Address 4 (optional), Address 5 (optional), Country, Telephone, Email (Primary), Email (Secondary) (optional).

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/EditParticipantDetails.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The page loads and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
steps.expected: The h1 reads My account and a second heading reads Edit Participant Details.

steps.action: Look at the contact and address fields.
steps.expected: The fields Contact Name, Organisation Name, Address 1, Address 2, Address 3, Address 4 and Address 5 are visible.

steps.action: Look at the Country, Telephone and email fields.
steps.expected: The fields Country, Telephone, Email (Primary) and Email (Secondary) are visible.

steps.action: Open the Country list without choosing a value.
steps.expected: The list is populated and contains Afghanistan.

steps.action: Look at the buttons below the form without selecting them.
steps.expected: The buttons UPDATE DETAILS and CANCEL are visible.

test_cases.title: Submitting participant details without a Country is blocked
acs: DERIVED: Submitting with Country empty shows The Country for this participant must be specified and saves nothing - route /EditParticipantDetails.aspx (crawl, docs/discovery/coverage-plan.md)
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
Nothing is saved and the form stays unlocked, so no data cleanup is needed.
The seeded Country value may be pre-filled; the step that clears it is part of the test (see open_questions).

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/EditParticipantDetails.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The h1 reads My account and the form is editable.

steps.action: Clear the Country field so that no country is selected.
steps.expected: The Country field shows no selected country.

steps.action: Select UPDATE DETAILS.
steps.expected: The page stays on Edit Participant Details.

steps.action: Read the message shown for Country.
steps.expected: The message The Country for this participant must be specified is shown.

steps.action: Look for the submitted message.
steps.expected: The message Updated details submitted is not shown.

steps.action: Check the form fields and the UPDATE DETAILS button.
steps.expected: The fields are still editable and the form is not locked.

steps.action: Cleanup: select CANCEL.
steps.expected: The page leaves the form and no data has been changed.

test_cases.title: Cancel on participant details returns to Home without saving
acs: DERIVED: CANCEL on /EditParticipantDetails.aspx returns to /Home.aspx without saving - route /EditParticipantDetails.aspx (destination from the EditCustomerDetails.aspx.vb LeavePage pattern, participant page TODO confirm)
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
Test data: unique value Cancelled Contact <run id> typed into Contact Name and never submitted.
Nothing is saved, so no data cleanup is needed.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/EditParticipantDetails.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The h1 reads My account.

steps.action: Note the current value of Contact Name as <original contact name>.
steps.expected: The original value is recorded.

steps.action: Replace the Contact Name value with Cancelled Contact <run id>.
steps.expected: The Contact Name field shows Cancelled Contact <run id>.

steps.action: Select CANCEL.
steps.expected: The browser opens /Home.aspx and the h1 reads VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/EditParticipantDetails.aspx again.
steps.expected: The h1 reads My account and Contact Name shows <original contact name>, not Cancelled Contact <run id>.

steps.action: Cleanup: select CANCEL.
steps.expected: The browser returns to /Home.aspx and no data has been changed.

test_cases.title: A valid participant update is submitted and the confirmation shows
acs: DERIVED: A valid submit shows Updated details submitted and locks the form while the change is pending - route /EditParticipantDetails.aspx (crawl; docs/04-potential-defects.md ENV-005)
assumptions: NOT repeatable: after one valid submit the form is locked permanently because the pending update is not visible in admin (ENV-005). Automate as @wip.
The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
Test data: Contact Name Jane Smith; Telephone <synthetic telephone number>; Email (Primary) test@example.com; Country Afghanistan.
Cleanup is not possible from the UI; the pending update needs a database reset (see open_questions).

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/EditParticipantDetails.aspx as a signed-in external user whose form is not locked.
steps.expected: The h1 reads My account and the form is editable.

steps.action: Enter Jane Smith in Contact Name and test@example.com in Email (Primary).
steps.expected: The two fields show the entered values.

steps.action: Enter <synthetic telephone number> in Telephone.
steps.expected: The Telephone field shows the entered value.

steps.action: Choose Afghanistan in Country and check that every required field is filled.
steps.expected: Country shows Afghanistan and no validation message is shown.

steps.action: Select UPDATE DETAILS.
steps.expected: The message Updated details submitted is shown.

steps.action: Read the text that follows the message.
steps.expected: The text reads Changes have already been submitted. Please wait for those changes to be approved or rejected before submitting further changes.

steps.action: Cleanup: ask the environment owner to reset the database to remove the pending update.
steps.expected: The form on /EditParticipantDetails.aspx is editable again after the reset.
